title: Accessibility: Screen reader support
description: Part of larger accessibility ticket #148. Add aria-live regions for dynamic content and screen reader compatibility. **Requirements:** - Add aria-live regions for dynamic content (notifications, errors, game updates) - Use aria-live="polite" for non-urgent updates - Use aria-live="assertive" for urgent messages - Add aria-labels to form inputs with clear descriptions - Use aria-labelledby to relate labels to inputs - Provide alternative text for images (alt attributes) - Add skip navigation link (skip to main content) **Implementation Steps:** 1. Identify all dynamic content areas (notifications, errors, game updates) 2. Add aria-live="polite" to non-urgent dynamic content 3. Add aria-live="assertive" to urgent messages (errors) 4. Add skip navigation link at top of app 5. Add aria-labelledby to all form inputs 6. Add alt text to all images 7. Test with screen reader (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) **Files:** - App.vue (skip link) - Components with dynamic content (notifications, game updates) - Form components - All elements **Estimated Effort:** 2-3 hours **Priority:** Medium **Dependencies:** None **Note**: This is sub-task 4 of ticket #148 (Accessibility - 12-16 hours total)
